title: Four-rod H-frame pylon
description: Norwegian H-frames sometimes have a unique design: legs made of four metal rods with multiple crossbars. They can get very tall, and are only rarely seen in Iceland. Found from the south up to Troms.

title: Delta pylon in Norway
description: Delta pylons are mainly found in southern Norway, occasionally in the north. Sweden has virtually none, which makes them useful for a Norway/Sweden 50/50.
